item.title: Footpath paving subsidence close to Criffel Avenue southbound bus stop., 8th September
item.description:
The pavement on the north east side of Thornton Avenue, just south of the "Criffel Avenue" southbound bus stop, has been steadily subsiding and needs relaying as it now very unlevel. After even a modest rainfall large puddles form as the paving stones are below the kerb level. This stretch of pavement is heavily used by residents from adjacent streets walking to/from the bus stop.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Thornton Avenue, Streatham Hill, Greater London
